'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] enter the [[Gaza Strip]] from multiple directions with [[infantry]] and tanks. Heavy clashes were reported. [https://nymag.com/intelligencer/article/israel-hamas-war-live-updates-gaza-invasion.html (''New York Magazine'')]
***[[Israel]]i troops advance on the city of [[Beit Hanoun]]. [https://theatlasnews.co/brief/2023/10/27/palestinian-sources-report-idf-armor-advancements-on-beit-hanoun-intense-strikes-continue/ (''The Atlas News'')]
**At least 33 [[Palestinians]] are killed and several are injured, following Israeli airstrikes on at least three [[residential]] neighbourhoods in [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/27/israel-hamas-war-live-israel-bombs-gaza-overnight-more-than-7000-dead (Al Jazeera)]
**At least 10 Palestinians are killed, including [[journalist]] Yasser Abu Namous and his mother, in a series of airstrikes carried out by Israeli forces in southern Gaza. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/27/israel-hamas-war-live-israel-bombs-gaza-overnight-more-than-7000-dead (Al Jazeera)]
**Several people are killed or injured in an Israeli airstrike on the [[Al-Shati refugee camp]] which destroyed residential buildings and a nearby [[mosque]]. [https://www.tbsnews.net/hamas-israel-war/israel-bombs-gaza-overnight-more-7000-dead-727474 (The Business Standard)]
**The [[Palestinian Red Crescent]] says that its medics were shot at by Israeli forces as they treated an injured person in [[Tubas (city)|Tubas]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.tbsnews.net/hamas-israel-war/israel-bombs-gaza-overnight-more-7000-dead-727474 (The Business Standard)]
**Six people are injured after a [[missile]] hits a building in [[Taba, Egypt|Taba]], [[Egypt]]. Israel says that the missile was launched from [[Yemen]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/missile-that-egypt-likely-came-from-yemen-idf-says-as-second-sinai-impact-reported/ (The Times of Israel)] 
**Four people are killed in a pre-dawn raid by Israeli forces in the West Bank. At least 19 people have been arrested. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/27/israel-hamas-war-live-israel-bombs-gaza-overnight-more-than-7000-dead (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Hamas]] reports that Israel has disrupted most [[Communications in the State of Palestine|communication]] and internet services in the Gaza Strip. [https://www.onmanorama.com/news/world/2023/10/27/israel-palestine-conflict-ground-war-to-begin-soon.html (AFP via ''Onmanorama'')]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021-present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**Various rebel groups across [[Myanmar]], including the [[Myanmar National Democratic Alliance Army]], the [[Ta'ang National Liberation Army]], the [[Arakan Army]], and local defense groups, launch an offensive in northern [[Shan State]] and capture several towns and junta outposts. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/war-against-the-junta/ethnic-alliance-attacks-myanmar-junta-targets-across-northern-shan.html (The Irrawaddy)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***Pro-[[Russia]]n official [[Oleg Tsaryov]] is critically injured in an [[assassination]] attempt by unknown assailants in [[Crimea]] and is reported to be in [[Intensive care medicine|intensive care]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-pro-russian-politician-tsaryov-intensive-care-after-being-shot-2023-10-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[American intervention in the Syrian civil war]]
***The [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] says that it has conducted [[airstrike]]s on [[Iran]]-backed targets in [[Syria]] linked to the [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]]. [https://apnews.com/article/syria-airstrikes-iran-revolutionary-guard-af3c7a0f069b8c8b08f6feaa0e165d6a (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
***The [[UN General Assembly]] passes a [[United Nations General Assembly Resolution ES-10/21|resolution]] by a vote of 120–14, with 45 abstentions, calling for an immediate humanitarian [[truce]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], despite [[US]] and [[Israel]]i opposition. [https://apnews.com/article/un-resolution-vote-israel-hamas-gaza-truce-7eec00b0e28ef2036636b166b48ca030 (AP)]
*The [[Financial Action Task Force]] adds [[Bulgaria]] to its "[[Financial Action Task Force blacklist|grey list]]" for increased monitoring due to strategic deficiencies in countering [[money laundering]] and [[terrorism financing]]. [https://tribune.net.ph/2023/10/bulgaria-placed-on-international-money-laundering-grey-list/ (AFP via ''Daily Tribune'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**Thousands of people gather in [[Chile]]'s capital [[Santiago]] to protest against [[Israel]]'s military actions in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.cairnspost.com.au/news/world/thousands-rally-in-chilean-capital-santiago-to-protest-against-israeli-militarys-actions-in-gaza/video/ed8c98a0ea0275aa18da9069042dabda (''The Cairns Post'')]
*[[2023 Lewiston shootings]]
**Authorities in [[Maine]], [[United States]], confirm the death of Robert Card, the suspected perpetrator of a [[Mass shootings in the United States|mass shooting]] that killed 18 in [[Lewiston, Maine|Lewiston]], with indications of a [[Suicide|self-inflicted gunshot wound]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20231028-suspect-in-maine-mass-shooting-found-dead (AFP via France 24)]
*Aftermath of the [[2023 Mozambican local elections]]
**Protests occur across [[Mozambique]], particularly in the city of [[Nampula]], against the results of local elections which locals claim were rigged. Ten people are injured in clashes with police. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/violent-protests-break-out-mozambique-after-local-elections-2023-10-27/ (Reuters)]
*Aftermath of the [[assassination of Jovenel Moïse]]
**A retired [[Colombia]]n army officer who participated in the 2021 assassination of [[Haiti]]an president [[Jovenel Moïse]] is sentenced to life in prison by a court in [[Miami]], United States. [https://apnews.com/article/haiti-moise-president-killed-miami-3236a13f74c3ff5fa5300c21e314dc81 (AP)]
*The [[Philippine National Police]] detain almost 600 individuals during a [[Police raid|raid]] on a suspected [[Human trafficking in the Philippines|human trafficking]] and [[Internet fraud]] hub in [[Manila]], with nationals from multiple countries present. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/philippines-trafficking-scams-600-people-detained-3879956 (AFP via CNA)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Sultan of Johor|Sultan]] [[Ibrahim Ismail of Johor]] is selected as [[Malaysia]]'s 17th [[Yang di-Pertuan Agong]] by [[Conference of Rulers|the nation's royalty]], set to be inaugurated following the end of [[Abdullah of Pahang|the current king]]'s term on 31 January 2024. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1784370/sultan-ibrahim-elected-malaysias-next-king (AFP via ''Dawn'')]
